title.narrative: Opinion and the Other One - Consultant regarding Danes attitudes and knowledge of SDG's (2)

description.narrative:
Since 2018, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs has carried out an annual analysis of Danes' attitudes and knowledge of the UN's global goals, development cooperation and conditions in developing countries. In addition to this, five segments (incl. personas) have been defined in 2018 based on Danes' knowledge and attitudes - from the very enthusiastic to the very skeptical. The analyzes form the basis for strengthening, targeting and versioning of communication activities in order to create the greatest possible impact. Furthermore, the analyzes are used to form the basis for strategic choices and resource prioritization in the area of ??communication. In addition, from time to time the Ministry of Foreign Affairs wants to learn more about selected trends, topics or questions that the attitude and knowledge analysis gives rise to a deeper investigation.
To that end, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs conducts a public tender for a four-year framework agreement for the analysis task. Five actors have bid for the task and now the Ministry of Foreign Affairs wants to hire a consultant to provide analytical expertise on the tenderers' proposed solutions.
This is the second contract related to this task, as we needed further assistance to complete the tender.

This is a consultancy contract with no results framework.
